annotations.title: Screen current versus proposed permit-impact facts

description: FREE PERMIT-CHANGE IMPACT PREFLIGHT for an EXISTING England waste operation when both current and proposed operating facts are available. Compare modelled fields such as location, activities, waste types, quantity, storage, treatment or operating hours. Returns changed fields, findings, official evidence and review actions; it is read-only and does not vary a permit or decide that a variation/new permit is legally required. Do NOT use for a brand-new operation route, carrier registration, or DWT receipt-reporting readiness.

current.description: Current operating facts. Supply only facts actually known from the existing operation/authorisation.

nation.description: UK nation. This workflow currently supports England only.
nation.title: Nation

proposed.description: Proposed operating facts to compare against current facts. The tool identifies changed modelled fields but does not decide that a permit variation is legally required.

hazardous_status.description: Known hazardous-waste status; never infer it.
hazardous_status.title: Hazardous Status

maximum_quantity.description: Current or proposed maximum quantity, preserving the user's unit/context.
maximum_quantity.title: Maximum Quantity

waste_types.description: Current or proposed user-supplied waste types/codes.
waste_types.title: Waste Types

name: waste_permit_change_preflight
